text: RESULTS: Dilated bowel segments with absence of gas in the rectum, suggesting a possible obstruction

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Duodenal Atresia

The X-ray findings of dilated bowel segments with an absent gas bubble in the rectum strongly indicate a complete intestinal obstruction, specifically pointing to duodenal atresia given your infant's age and lack of meconium passage. This condition typically presents as the "double bubble" sign on imaging.
